SMALLER FOOTPRINT. SMALLER PRICE. In 2016 we released Andy Timmons' signature overdrive, the AT — or as everybody ended up calling it, "the @." It started in 2013 when Andy bought a JHS Angry Charlie and made it his main lead channel, beating out the distortion channels of the boutique amps he's known for. We met at NAMM, discussed some ideas for his own version, and soon after, the AT was born. The AT Mini is the original V1 AT circuit, permanently set in Andy's preferred 100-watt mode — the open, loud, less-compressed voicing with the most volume and the most amp-like crunch. No toggle. Just the setting the guy whose name is on the pedal uses. If you need the most authentic British distortion lead and rhythm sound you can find — one that perfectly replicates the punch, saturation, and unmistakable feeling of standing in front of a stack of loud amplifiers — this is it. WHAT'S DIFFERENT This is the same exact circuit as the V1. Same four knobs. Smaller box, smaller price. FIRST: We put it in a new enclosure — a compact case that gives you back valuable board real estate. SECOND: We removed the wattage toggle and set the voicing to 100 watts. THAT'S IT: Volume, Drive, EQ, and Air all work exactly as they always have. If you want the 25-watt and 50-watt voicings, or the independent footswitchable boost channel, that's the AT+. Still in the JHS Pedals catalog. Still $219. If you want Andy's tone with Andy's exact setting in a smaller footprint for $129, this is it. CONTROLS VOLUME – Controls the output volume. DRIVE – Controls the amount of drive and gain, just like a tube amp being cranked at high volumes. Wide range from high-gain blues to thunderous distortion. EQ – A high pass filter that naturally brightens or darkens the overall tone of the pedal. Right is brighter, left is darker. AIR – Just like the presence knob on an amp, this lets you dial in the perfect amount of high end for compatibility with any amp. Right is brighter, left is darker. JACKS INPUT – 1/4" right jack. OUTPUT – 1/4" left jack. POWER – Requires 9VDC to 18VDC center negative power and consumes 10mA. SPECS True bypass switching Four controls: Volume, Drive, EQ, Air Fixed 100-watt voicing 9VDC to 18VDC center negative, 10mA Assembled in Kansas City THIS PEDAL MEASURES 1.96" X 3.93" X 1.21" AND CONSUMES 10mA. IT CAN BE SAFELY RUN ON 9 OR 18 VOLTS. Recently viewed next

Originally released in 2016 as the AT (or "the @"), the Andy Timmons signature overdrive quickly became a staple for players seeking premium, amp-like saturation. Now, the JHS AT Mini takes the highly sought-after V1 circuit and packs it into a pedalboard-friendly enclosure. If you are looking for the most authentic British distortion available—one that perfectly replicates the punch, saturation, and unmistakable feel of standing in front of a stack of loud amplifiers—this is your pedal. What Makes the AT Mini Different? It's the exact same circuit as the original V1 AT, but streamlined for space and simplicity. Compact Enclosure: Reclaim valuable pedalboard real estate without sacrificing tone. Fixed 100-Watt Voicing: We removed the wattage toggle and permanently set the pedal to Andy’s preferred 100-watt mode. Enjoy an open, loud, and less-compressed voicing with maximum amp-like crunch. Accessible Price Point: Get Andy's exact tone and setting for only $129. Intuitive Controls The four classic knobs work exactly as they always have, allowing you to easily dial in your sound: VOLUME: Controls the master output. DRIVE: Controls the amount of gain.
